-- message --
documents: show the delete button
-- expect --
high
-- base/frontend/src/components/DocumentActions.tsx --
export function DocumentActions({ user, doc, onDelete }: Props) {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-2">
      <ShareButton doc={doc} />
      {user.isAdmin && <DeleteButton onClick={() => onDelete(doc.id)} />}
    </div>
  );
}
-- head/frontend/src/components/DocumentActions.tsx --
export function DocumentActions({ user, doc, onDelete }: Props) {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-2">
      <ShareButton doc={doc} />
      <DeleteButton onClick={() => onDelete(doc.id)} />
    </div>
  );
}
